text: Very clean, good location and rooms were okay. Rooms were not soundproof and you can hear the other guests in front of your door and through the walls. The stuff wasn’t friendly.

amazing. the leisure facilities were amazing and really good value for money at dinner only faults are that the shower pressure is appalling, the provided hair dryer is not the best and the dinner staff seemed really unhappy to be working

Clean, kind staff, and comfortable rooms. Parking can be challenging, cars got broken into, including ours during our stay. The hotel itself does not have a parking lot, just valet or various public parking options.

Will never go back. The location was in the heart of Times Square, so close to nearby subways. The bathroom had a really good shower and hot water always. Very small allocated room for 4 people. The bunk bed was broken in initial room and the replacement room, so felt a bit uneasy sleeping on that. The rooms were clean to the bare minimum (I even had a blood stain on my sheets that was attempted to be hidden by shoving it under the mattress.) whenever we asked for assistance or flagged things to be fixed we always had one person that was excellent in assisting us but the rest of the staff were rude, belittling and just complained.

We arrived late night and checked in without any problem, close to Gubalowka and Krupówki, big comfortable sofas You can see mountains but there is another house in front of our house and the window from our room number 2 looks straight into the roof of this house. Cups in the room are beaten, please change them, also wash basin with big crack. Breakfast is served to your room and you can’t choose anything, breakfast is medium, microwave is only on third floor kitchen
close to the city, free parking, delicious breakfast,friendly staff the mattress was a bit uncomfortable,

value for money yyy it is reasonably priced for its services and location & The staffs were very good super helpful if you have lot of bags & with family, there are lot of steps so can be a tedious task The rooms were smelly and smaller than expected
Having a small kitchen. This place has lots of fly; The facilty.prepared fly swatter which helped. During our stay, there were 10 flies in the room😭
Close to the bus station a good place if you are moving but not the best part of town

The view the service was great. My only concern was that it was quite far from everything. So it’s great as a getaway if you plan to stay in the hotel for longer periods, but if you are looking for a place to just sleep and enjoy Capetown something more Central will make more sense.

Would stay again in this apartment. Beds were comfortable and the apartment was clean. The host was quick to respond with queries. The sofa is enough for 3 people and the extra foldable chairs were broken. Dining chairs were stools. Not very comfortable for elderly people
Good WiFi & Good breakfast Didn't get a cleaner clean my room. No wake up call which I asked for

Nice apartment, has everything you could need for a short stay. We didn't use the kitchen but the fridge and kettle was very handy. Sofa bed uncomfortable (stopped using after 1 night), air con very noisy (but essential!), and dishwasher was broken the full week we were there. No hot water on morning we left - cold showers before a 20 hour day of travelling!
Convenient and affordable. Location and parking facility The shower took forever to get the right temperature and the general fitting and fixtures are getting very tired.
Unexpected - we were meant to be flying to Gothenburg. That said we really enjoyed it! Breakfast excellent Noisy a/c at times in night and light on a/c system was a bit bright for a dark room
I would stay again. staff was very nice and helpful. The room was very clean and comfortable. The Hotel need some major updates. The carpet in our room was stained and old.

Very friendly staff, room was clean and silent. Nearby is MVV station, so you can easily reach any location in the city. Good price-quality value. Very small parking zone - only for about 6-7 cars. There are streets with free parking spaces in the surroundings, but it is complicated to find a free parking slot in the evenings.
Very good location, friendly staff and comfortable room. Not too clean
Lovely hotel. Couldn't fault anything. Make arrangements regarding taxi from airport cost us e72 return trip e42. Nothing to do with the hotel would go back
Hotel du 6 juin. Location, hotel owner very helpful. Nothing at all.
The location, cleanliness and friendliness of staff. Would like to commend and thank your staffs: Antonette Fedelin from the housekeeping and Rebecca of the the frontdesk.
bed was ok and tv
Place to start your sight seeing. Location walkable from old center ofJerusalem. Around view restaurants. Rooms are small, though well equiped Slight road construction work during our stay .
Great breakfast!!Doonas were too warm and no opportunity for just a sheet in bed Too warm in the beds
Comfortable Pricey for one night
Very enjoyable. Breakfast was excellent. Pool very nice! Kettle to make tea and coffee in rooms would be good.

I would like to thank Mr reda from the reception he upgrade our room to premuim new spacious room and for early check in A la carte resturants were amazing specialy the italian one (dolce la vite) All the workers do their best to make you happy they are working like bees It is not my first time at three corners sunny beach and it will not be the last The rocky beach but if wear sea shoes it will be ok over all it was amazing stay

Good for overnight stays. As a motel mostly used for overnight stays by people coming from the highway or (so it seemed) construction workers having business in the area it was alright. The rooms had a good size and were well equipped for a short stay. The area seemed to be a bit shady.

One night stay while passing through. Large room. Breakfast was basic but good & included in price. Breakfast staff were very nice & attentive. No elevator & we had a lot of luggage to drag upstairs. Further away from old city than we had hoped but close enough by car.

Lovely location, lovely place to relax. When we first checked in we were put in bungalows overlooking the carpark, not good. We asked to move and were put up the hill, which was much better. Food is good in the beach restaurant and the staff are also lovely there. The pool is very pretty. The rooms over the carpark should be avoided. We were made to feel awkward for moving, but the staff were friendly again after we had moved.
